newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET - Play abandoned for day with Poms 154-3.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - Play abandoned for day with Poms 154-3.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Jan 14 - Heavy rain forced the abandonment of play on the second day of England's cricket tour match against a New Zealand Selection 11 at Fitzherbert Park on Tuesday.
Play was called off for the day shortly after 1pm after umpires had taken an early lunch break due to showers.
England, in 56 minutes of play this morning, had advanced their overnight score from 106 for three wickets to 154-3, in reply to the New Zealand Selection's 138.
Alec Stewart and Nasser Hussain had produced an unbroken fourth-wicket partnership of 49 runs, with Stewart moving from 40 overnight to 75 and Nasser Hussain advancing to 11.
